items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: that boy out there, had a boy named Willie Jones come up there one time and ate Freddie up.

ctx.x: Come on, I'll buy you some beer, here -- give him what he want -- glug, glug, glug, glug, glug.

Now, Freddie is up there frantic. So, now, we are playing and Freddie was up there trembling and, trembling like a dog, making away with some bones -- and you know how a dog does, he was shaking and going on and Bill said, well, let's play something, Freddie said man, let's play something fast because that boy out there, had a boy named Willie Jones come up there one time and ate Freddie up.

And I clapped my hands -- Freddie said, I'm going to kill you. I thought you was my friend but you liked that man there, the way he was playing and I said, Freddie, I'm just clapping for professional reasons, you know. But I think you like him. I says, naw. I don't like him that much you my man. All right, then. Okay, now, be careful.
